description: Look up Dota 2 matches, players, heroes and teams.

opendota_new_player_match_trigger.description: Runs for each new player match in OpenDota. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields match_id, start_time, hero_id, duration, radiant_win

opendota_new_professional_match_trigger.description: Runs for each new professional match in OpenDota. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields match_id, leagueid, radiant_name, dire_name, start_time

opendota_new_team_match_trigger.description: Runs for each new team match in OpenDota. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields match_id, start_time, radiant, radiant_win
